title: Chapter 50 Go To The Ten Thousand Spirit Realm
content:
Chapter 50 Go To The Ten Thousand Spirit Realm

Hearing the call from the Ice Phoenix Clan leader, all the Phoenix Clan members present did not object.

Because at this moment they were still immersed in the terrifying aura of Lu Xue.

After a moment, the aura dissipated, and when everyone reacted.

But they had already seen the Ice Phoenix Clan leader walk to Lu Xue's side and said gently: "Little girl, what's your name?"

At this moment, the clan rules had long been forgotten.

This is a rare peerless monster in the world, and it is also a peerless monster of the ice system. What can he refuse.

"My name is Lu Xue."

Lu Xue said timidly.

She is not stupid, she knows very well the weight of the person in front of her.

The patriarch of the Ice Phoenix Clan is as famous as the behemoth Dragon Clan.

"Lu Xue, what a good name, are you willing to worship me as your master?"

The Ice Phoenix Clan leader continued.

At this moment, the face of the Ice Phoenix Clan leader was full of confidence.

He believed that the other party would never refuse. If he put forward the idea of accepting disciples in the outside world, the creatures coming to their Phoenix Clan would probably fill the entire Phoenix Domain.

Who is he? He is the patriarch of the Ice Phoenix Clan!

Hearing this, the Phoenix Clan members around were immediately shocked.

The patriarch actually wanted to accept that human woman as a disciple.

Seeing this scene, the Fire Phoenix Clan leader snorted coldly and then left directly.

He knew that it was impossible to expel that human woman.

If his Fire Phoenix Clan could have a peerless monster of that level, even if the other party was a pig, he would stay.

When Lu Xue heard the words of the Ice Phoenix Clan leader, Yan Luo was already shaking Lu Xue's arm excitedly before she could react.

"Xiaoxue, agree quickly, why are you still standing there?"

As long as Lu Xue became the disciple of their Ice Phoenix Clan leader, then Lu Xue's safety would no longer be a concern.

More importantly, Lu Xue could also stay in their Phoenix Clan openly.

However, the next moment, everyone was dumbfounded.

Lu Xue hesitated and said, "I, I already have a master."

Upon hearing this, Yan Luo and the Ice Phoenix Clan leader were stunned.

Is this a rejection? !

What a joke.

At this time, Yan Luo hurriedly said, "Xiaoxue, having a master does not mean that you can no longer worship others as your master. Everyone teaches something different."

The Ice Phoenix Clan leader also nodded in agreement.

It is normal for such a monstrous genius to already have a master.

But the so-called master of the other party is definitely not as good as himself, as can be seen from Lu Xue's current weak cultivation.

Hearing Yan Luo's words, Lu Xue was obviously a little surprised.

"Can I really worship two masters?"

Yan Luo nodded decisively and said, "Of course."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue looked at the Ice Phoenix Clan leader next to him again, and after a moment of silence, Lu Xue immediately said, "Okay, then I will worship you as a master."

There was some helplessness in her tone.

Suddenly, the Phoenix tribe members who had not yet left were dumbfounded again.

So reluctant? !

It was as if the other party was begging you to worship him as a master.

Is there any justice?

The Phoenix tribe leader twitched his mouth slightly. Who is worshipping whom as a master?

Should I kowtow to the other party to thank him for worshipping me as a master?

Taking a deep breath, Han Yun kept reminding himself that this was a rare and peerless evildoer in the world, and he was also an ice genius. He must hold back.

Then, Han Yun forced a gentle smile and said with a smile: "Then perform the worship ceremony."

Yan Luo, who was standing aside, was afraid that Lu Xue would say something else, so she winked at Lu Xue.

Seeing this, Lu Xue was no longer vague and performed the worship ceremony directly.

In this way, Lu Xue officially became the apprentice of Han Yun, the leader of the Ice Phoenix tribe.

From now on, he will be protected by the Ice Phoenix tribe.

......

However, accidents always come suddenly.

One day, the Grand Elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan failed to break through and finally came out of seclusion. His life span was almost gone and he seemed to be running out of time.

But at this moment, he saw Lu Xue.

Feeling Lu Xue's pure Ice Phoenix bloodline and strong physique, the Grand Elder was overjoyed. He ignored Han Yun's dissuasion and forced Lu Xue to become his furnace.

Han Yun was powerless to do anything about it.

Lu Xue could indeed become a powerful force of their Ice Phoenix Clan in the future, and even lead the Ice Phoenix Clan to glory.

But that was only in the future.

The immediate interests were obviously more important.

The Grand Elder was a strong man in the Heaven Realm. Now, the Ice Phoenix Clan could not do without the Grand Elder.

So, he could only watch Lu Xue die.

However, what he didn't expect was that Lu Xue actually had a rare treasure, not only successfully injured the Grand Elder, but also escaped from the Phoenix Domain.

The Grand Elder was furious and immediately issued a wanted notice for Lu Xue throughout the Wanling Realm.

The reward made countless creatures excited. The most precious thing was that they could get a favor from the Grand Elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan.

That was a favor from a powerful person in the Heaven Realm.

Then, countless creatures in the Wanling Realm wanted to find Lu Xue and hand her over to the Ice Phoenix Clan.

"It seems that you and I are not destined to be master and apprentice."

Looking at the sky in the distance, Han Yun shook his head slightly, his expression full of regret, and then whispered to Yan Luo who was crying beside him: "Go back, I can't do anything about this."

Hearing this answer, Yan Luo's face turned pale.

"Xiaoxue, I'm sorry, I hurt you, I shouldn't have brought you to the Phoenix Clan."

At this time, somewhere in the Wanling Realm.

Lu Xue was wearing a cloak, covering herself tightly, fearing that others would see it.

"I never thought that the old man was so bad, fortunately I have a lot of treasures."

"Hey, dad, come quickly, my daughter has become a street rat."

Time flies,,,

.........

Hongmeng Universe, Tianxuan World.

In the deserted city.

A feeling of uneasiness arises from the bottom of my heart.

Lu Daosheng suddenly woke up from his deep sleep.

"Xiaoxue?"

For some reason, Lu Daosheng always feels a little uneasy these days.

As a strong man in the destiny realm, it is definitely not an illusion.

If it weren't for his perception that his daughter was still safe and sound, he would have killed the Wanling Realm now.

Taking a deep breath, Lu Daosheng slowly said: "It's time."

The next moment, in the deserted city, the ancient bell that had been silent for a long time vibrated again.

The huge bell sound soon rang throughout the Xuangu Galaxy.

Suddenly, countless strong men rushed here.

At this time, the deserted city was already crowded with people.

As early as a hundred years ago, Lu Daosheng announced that he would set off for another world a hundred years later.

There is a higher level world.

For a while, countless creatures in the Hongmeng universe came to the deserted city.

"The time has come."

"It's finally here. I have been waiting for decades."

"Hehe, I have been waiting for a hundred years."

Everyone looked at the direction of the City Lord's Mansion with expectation, and they began to imagine what another higher level world would look like.

In the main hall of the City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and the world in his palm opened.

Gu Chen, Yunqi and others immediately came out of the world in their palms.

Buzz——

Since the construction of this hall, this is the first time that there has been a ripple in the hall.

That is the strong breath of Gu Chen and others.

"Meet the Lord of the City!"

As soon as they saw Lu Daosheng, Gu Chen and others immediately said respectfully.

Still the same as before.

Lu Daosheng glanced at everyone one by one.

They all became stronger.

Moreover, they became much stronger.

The lowest strength of several people reached the eighth level of the Earth Realm.

And Huang Shou even reached the peak of the ninth level of the Earth Realm.

His aura shocked the people around him.

With such strength, it is more than enough to go to the World of All Spirits.

They did not disappoint Lu Daosheng.

"Now, it's time to go to the World of All Spirits."

At this time, Lu Daosheng said slowly.
